title: Chris Kelly's appearance and barrelhouse style
summary: Kelly was dark brown, a poor dresser, and played barrelhouse music with mutes.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Can you tell us more about Chris Kelly now? What kind of a fellow was he? I don't even know if he was big or little or light or dark or what did he look like?
Oh, he was a kind of dark brown kid fellow. Well he didn't dress so well. He was really badass already.
Feralhouse type, was that the type he played the music to?
Yeah, he played the barrelhouse music. Feralhouse music.
You say you used a lot of mutes.
